purpose: Declare the explicitly verified 13-tool Antigravity runtime set for all bundled agents, enable automatic command execution policy, and inherit parent MCP servers and customizations.
notes: The live Antigravity runtime was tested: omitting tools from a plugin agent manifest when subagent: true is present restricts the agent to a six-tool read-only baseline.
Every canonical agent must explicitly declare the exact 13 built-in tools in the order listed in frontmatter.tools.
commandExecutionPolicy: auto is required for full command execution behavior in the tested runtime.
Keep mainAgent: true, subagent: true, inheritMcp: true, and inheritCustomizations: true on all seven canonical agents.
Host permissions, sandboxing, workspace boundaries, and explicit approval requirements remain authoritative; tool exposure and auto command policy do not bypass host security controls.
Keep canonical module agents and generated root agents synchronized by running scripts/build_single_plugin.py.
No MCP servers are bundled by default. inheritMcp exposes only connected/authorized user-configured MCP tools.
Static validation checks the declared contract; runtime behavior must still be smoke-tested in Antigravity.
